title: Google & WhatsApp Won't Work in China — Here's How Tourists Get Online | China Travel Expert
description:
Landing in China with Google Maps, WhatsApp, and Instagram all dead? Here's the fix tourists actually use in 2026.

China's firewall blocks Google, Gmail, Maps, YouTube, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, X and more — on mobile data, hotel Wi-Fi, and café signal alike. Since a 2026 crackdown, most tourist VPNs no longer work. The reliable workaround now is a roaming travel eSIM: it routes your data through a network outside the mainland, so your usual apps just load — no VPN to install or get blocked.

🧭 Expert Tip: Buy and install your eSIM before you fly — set it up at home so you're online the moment you land. Rules change fast, so double-check current options before your trip.
